notes.title: Robbing Time Demo Date Announced
notes.content:
Robbing Time Demo Announced


We are very excited to announce that our demo will be released on 14th of July. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3821300/Robbing_Time_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]

You will be able to play the demo solo or with a team of up to 5 people. The demo will allow you to tackle the first level (Crime City Central Bank) of the game in 2 modes: The Introduction and the Main Mode.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45663402/3b11850351cf4fe55f033b565970d88513fc94bd.png"]

The introduction is an easier and smaller version of the map, where you can learn the ropes of Robbing Time and how to rob the bank. After that, prove your worth in Main Mode, where the objective will be harder and the Superhero will be right on your tail from the start!
